chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

If a man commits zina and is flogged, it is not proper for the Imam to banish him from the land in which he was flogged to another land. Rather, it is only upon the Imam to expel him from the city in which he was flogged.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, meaning the lawful authority who implements the ruling
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina, meaning illicit sexual intercourse
key_terms.فَجُلِدَ: was flogged as the prescribed hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: After a man is flogged for zina, how far may the Imam banish him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the punishment of a man convicted of zina after the hadd of flogging has been carried out. It states that the Imam should not exile him from the broader land entirely, but should remove him only from the city where the punishment was administered, indicating a specific limit in implementing banishment.
